cards.title: Throne Room
cards.description: A grand hall with vaulted ceilings and stained-glass windows depicting past Harvest Festivals. King Aldric sits on a carved wooden throne, fidgeting with a festival program. Pip stands nearby, arms full of scrolls. Tapestries show knights of increasing rank — Soldier, Scout, Marshal, Chronicler, Champion.
cards.image_prompt: A grand medieval throne room with soaring vaulted ceilings and tall stained-glass windows casting jewel-toned light. A jovial king in golden robes sits on an ornate carved wooden throne, fidgeting with a scroll. A small eager apprentice stands nearby clutching an armful of scrolls. Five tapestries along the wall depict knights of ascending rank. Warm golden light, rich parchment tones, ornate stone columns.

cards.title: Steward's Study
cards.description: A cozy room with a large oak desk, an errand board on the wall showing five tasks with wax seals, and a shelf of handbooks. A speaking tube connects to the courtyard below — used to dispatch knights. Pip's notes are scattered everywhere. A Knight Rank Chart hangs beside the door.
cards.image_prompt: A cozy medieval study with a large oak desk covered in scattered parchment notes. A wooden errand board on the wall displays five tasks with red wax seals. A brass speaking tube protrudes from the wall. Bookshelves filled with leather-bound handbooks. A knight rank chart hangs beside a heavy wooden door. Warm candlelight, quill and ink on the desk, intimate scholarly atmosphere.

cards.title: Castle Kitchen
cards.description: A cavernous kitchen with iron pots hanging from ceiling hooks, a roaring hearth, and shelves upon shelves of recipe scrolls. Greta the Head Cook stands amid the chaos, flour in her hair, waving a ladle like a scepter. The recipe archive — hundreds of scrolls in wooden cubbyholes — dominates the far wall.
cards.image_prompt: A cavernous medieval castle kitchen with iron pots hanging from ceiling hooks and a roaring stone hearth. A stout woman in an apron with flour in her hair waves a wooden ladle like a scepter. The far wall is dominated by a massive wooden shelf of cubbyholes stuffed with recipe scrolls. Warm firelight, steam rising, copper pans gleaming, chaotic but lively atmosphere.

cards.title: Chronicle Hall
cards.description: A hushed, vaulted chamber lined with shelves of glowing memory crystals — each one a preserved record of past events. A large circular table in the center holds a timeline display where crystals can be placed in sequence. The air shimmers faintly. Dust motes drift through beams of colored light from high windows.
cards.image_prompt: A hushed vaulted medieval chamber lined with shelves of softly glowing blue and purple crystals. A large circular stone table in the center has six carved slots arranged in a timeline. Beams of colored light stream through high arched windows, illuminating dust motes. Shimmering magical atmosphere, deep blues and purples, ancient and mystical.

cards.title: Castle Gate
cards.description: A massive stone gatehouse with iron portcullis and a control room full of conduit pipes — each one a channel connecting the castle to the outside world. The Gate Warden sits at a desk covered in connection diagrams. Beyond the gate, the sounds of the Bazaar drift in — merchants calling, coins clinking, music playing.
cards.image_prompt: A massive medieval stone gatehouse with a heavy iron portcullis half-raised. A control room to one side with copper conduit pipes running along the walls, each labeled with a small tag. A grizzled warden sits at a desk covered in parchment diagrams. Beyond the gate, a colorful marketplace is visible in the distance. Cool stone interior contrasting with warm golden light from outside.

cards.title: Bedrock Bazaar
cards.description: A bustling town square marketplace ringed by colorful merchant stalls. Each stall flies a distinctive banner. The Anthropic Pavilion gleams with scholarly elegance. The Meta Tent echoes with boisterous laughter. The Nova Company guild hall dominates one corner. The DeepSeek Caravan sits quietly at the edge, star charts hanging from its awning.
cards.image_prompt: A bustling medieval town square marketplace ringed by colorful merchant stalls with distinctive banners. An elegant scholarly pavilion with white drapes on one side. A boisterous open tent with red and blue flags on another. A grand guild hall dominates one corner. A quiet caravan with star charts on its awning sits at the edge. Crowds of merchants and shoppers, warm golden afternoon light, festive atmosphere.

discoveries.label: Talk to the Nova Company Clerk
Recruit an ally for the Kitchen

cards.title: Foreign Quarter
cards.description: A colorful district of silk canopies, spice stalls, and unfamiliar scripts on every sign. Ambassador Kael stands in the middle of the street, gesturing wildly at a group of Eastern merchants who gesture back with equal confusion. The Tongue of Babel — a pair of twins from the Nova Company — wait nearby, ready to translate.
cards.image_prompt: A colorful medieval district with silk canopies in saffron and crimson, spice stalls overflowing with exotic goods, and signs in unfamiliar scripts. A well-dressed ambassador gestures animatedly at a group of Eastern merchants in ornate robes. Twin translators stand nearby watching. Warm spice-toned light, rich fabrics, exotic atmosphere, cobblestone street.

discoveries.label: Talk to the Tongue of Babel

cards.title: Entertainment Guild
cards.description: A theatrical hall with a miniature stage model in the center, showing the festival grounds with four performance areas. Mistress Thornbury sweeps across the room in a dramatic cape, gesturing at empty booking sheets. The Master Artificer from the Nova Company tinkers with a mechanical puppet in the corner.
cards.image_prompt: A theatrical medieval guild hall with velvet curtains and dramatic lighting. A miniature wooden stage model sits on a central table showing four tiny performance areas. A dramatic woman in a sweeping cape gestures grandly at empty booking sheets on the wall. In the corner, a tinkerer works on a small mechanical puppet. Warm stage-light glow, theatrical atmosphere, rich reds and golds.

cards.title: Noble Quarter
cards.description: An elegant district of manicured gardens and heraldic banners. Lord Ashford's crimson pavilion faces Lady Birch's emerald pavilion across a cobblestone plaza. Both nobles stand with arms crossed, glaring at each other. The Court Painter from the Nova Company has set up an easel between them.
cards.image_prompt: An elegant medieval district with manicured gardens and heraldic banners. A crimson pavilion with a lion crest faces an emerald pavilion with a birch tree crest across a cobblestone plaza. Two nobles stand with arms crossed, glaring at each other. A painter with an easel is set up between them. Afternoon sunlight, rich heraldic colors, tense aristocratic atmosphere.

cards.title: The Proving Ground
cards.description: An open field outside the castle walls, ringed by training dummies and weapon racks. A large assembly platform stands in the center — a rack with labeled slots for each knight capability. Sir Cedric, a grizzled knight-commander with a scarred face and crossed arms, blocks the path to the Festival Grounds beyond.
cards.image_prompt: An open field outside medieval castle walls, ringed by training dummies and weapon racks. A large wooden assembly platform stands in the center with a rack of seven labeled slots. A grizzled knight-commander with a scarred face and crossed arms stands blocking a path. Castle walls in the background, late afternoon golden light, dust in the air, military training ground atmosphere.

cards.title: Rank Tapestry
cards.description: Five knight ranks depicted: Soldier (basic orders), Scout (tools + gateway), Marshal (policy + identity), Chronicler-Knight (memory + guardrails), Champion (all combined). Each rank shows which Bazaar merchants will work with that rank.
cards.image_prompt: A richly woven medieval tapestry showing five knight figures in ascending rank, each more ornately armored than the last. The lowest knight holds a simple scroll, the middle knights carry tools and shields, the highest knight gleams in full golden armor with a crown. Gold thread on deep burgundy fabric, illuminated manuscript border.

cards.title: Festival Program
cards.description: Schedule: Opening Ceremony (needs performers), Feast (needs menu), Trade Fair (needs foreign merchants), Decoration Judging (needs noble stalls), Grand Finale (needs Champion rehearsal). Five errands mapped to five events.
cards.image_prompt: An ornate parchment scroll with a festival schedule written in elegant calligraphy. Five sections marked with colorful wax seals — red, blue, green, gold, purple. Decorative vine borders, aged parchment texture, quill pen resting beside it. Warm candlelight illumination.

cards.title: Pip's Handbook
cards.description: "A knight is only as good as its instructions. Be specific! 'Fetch schedule' might get you a wooden plank. 'Fetch schedule from notice board' gets results." Also: "Higher-rank merchants demand higher-rank knights. The Meta Tent serves anyone. The Anthropic Pavilion demands a Marshal."
cards.image_prompt: A small, well-worn leather-bound handbook with dog-eared pages and ink stains. The cover has a simple embossed crest. Pages are visible with handwritten notes and doodles in the margins. A quill bookmark sticks out. Warm parchment tones, cozy study atmosphere.

cards.title: Errand Board
cards.description: Five wax-sealed errands: 1) The Feast Menu (Kitchen), 2) The Foreign Traders (Gate → Foreign Quarter), 3) The Entertainment Booking (Entertainment Guild), 4) The Decoration Dispute (Chronicle Hall → Noble Quarter), 5) The Grand Rehearsal (Proving Ground). Each shows required knight rank.
cards.image_prompt: A wooden notice board mounted on a stone wall with five parchment notices pinned to it, each sealed with a different colored wax seal. Iron pins hold the notices in place. A small lantern hangs beside the board casting warm light. Medieval castle wall texture, official and organized.

cards.title: Knight Rank Chart
cards.description: Soldier: prompt in, response out. Scout: + Gateway + tools. Marshal: + Policy + Identity. Chronicler-Knight: + Memory + Guardrails. Champion: all combined. Rank progression unlocks rooms and NPCs.
cards.image_prompt: An illuminated manuscript chart showing five tiers of knight progression, drawn in gold ink on aged parchment. Each tier shows a shield icon with increasing embellishments — from a plain shield to a crowned golden shield. Connected by ornate arrows. Gold leaf accents, deep blue and crimson details.

cards.title: Recipe Archive Shelves
cards.description: Hundreds of scrolls in cubbyholes, labeled by category but hopelessly jumbled. Categories visible: Appetizers, Soups, Mains, Desserts, Drinks, Preserves, Sauces. "Sorting them by proper course order would reveal the feast menu."
cards.image_prompt: A massive wooden shelf of cubbyholes stuffed with hundreds of rolled parchment scrolls, some spilling out. Small wooden labels on each section are barely readable. A few scrolls have fallen to the floor. Warm kitchen firelight, flour dust in the air, chaotic but charming.

cards.title: Greta's Cooking Pot
cards.description: A massive iron pot bubbling with something unidentifiable. A sticky note reads: "DO NOT TASTE — experimental. Last person who tried saw colors for three days."
cards.image_prompt: A massive black iron cauldron bubbling with a mysterious iridescent liquid, wisps of colorful steam rising. A small parchment note is pinned to the rim. Firelight from below, warm kitchen glow, slightly magical and ominous atmosphere.

cards.title: Memory Crystal Display
cards.description: A circular table with 6 slots arranged in a timeline. "Place memory fragments in chronological order to reconstruct a specific year's records." Currently empty.
cards.image_prompt: A circular stone table with six carved slots arranged in a line, each slot glowing faintly with residual blue-purple energy. The table surface has intricate carved runes. Currently empty, waiting for crystals. Mystical blue-purple ambient light, ancient stone texture.

cards.title: Chronicle Shelves
cards.description: Rows of crystals labeled by year and event. Most are dim. Six crystals glow brightly — fragments from recent festivals, ready to be sorted. A plaque reads: "Memory persists across sessions. What was learned yesterday serves today."
cards.image_prompt: Rows of shelves carved into stone walls, holding hundreds of small crystals. Most are dim and grey, but six crystals glow brightly in blue and purple. Small labels beneath each crystal. A brass plaque is mounted on the wall. Deep blue ambient light, mystical archive atmosphere.

cards.title: Gate Conduits
cards.description: Three conduit pipes on the left: Translation (speech services), Trade Ledger (merchant inventory), Currency Exchange (treasury). Six endpoints on the right: Nova Sonic Endpoint, Merchant Inventory API, Treasury Service, Weather Oracle, Courier Network, Bard's Archive. Three are correct, three are decoys.
cards.image_prompt: A stone wall with three copper conduit pipes on the left side and six pipe endpoints on the right side. The pipes have ornate brass fittings and small hanging tags. Some endpoints glow faintly, others are dark. A wiring diagram on parchment is pinned nearby. Industrial medieval aesthetic, copper and stone.

cards.title: Merchant Stall Directory
cards.description: Anthropic Pavilion (reasoning, nuance — requires Marshal rank, cost: 40g). Nova Company (four departments — varies). Meta Tent (general purpose — no rank required, cost: 15g). DeepSeek Caravan (math, logic, code — requires Chronicler rank, cost: 25g). Qwen Traders (multilingual — requires Scout rank, cost: 20g).
cards.image_prompt: A wooden signpost in a marketplace with five directional signs pointing different ways, each painted a different color with a merchant symbol. The signpost is decorated with carved vines. Cobblestone ground, colorful market stalls blurred in the background. Warm afternoon light, festive marketplace atmosphere.

cards.title: Foreign Trade Ledger
cards.description: Lists available goods: Saffron (50g), Silk Bolts (30g), Festival Fireworks (40g), Jade Figurines (25g — decoy), Exotic Tea (10g — decoy). Notes: "Merchants expect formal negotiation protocol. Greeting → Needs → Offer → Counter → Agreement."
cards.image_prompt: An open leather-bound trade ledger with columns of handwritten entries in ink. Small illustrations of goods in the margins — spices, silk, fireworks. A quill pen rests in the spine. Aged parchment pages, warm candlelight, merchant's desk atmosphere.

cards.title: Performance Stage Model
cards.description: Four stages on the model: Main Stage (large, open-air), Tavern Corner (small, intimate), Children's Area (safe, colorful), Grand Finale Stage (elevated, grand). Each has a drop zone for a performer type.
cards.image_prompt: A detailed miniature wooden model of festival grounds sitting on a table, showing four tiny stages with different designs — a large open-air stage, a cozy tavern corner, a colorful children's area, and an elevated grand finale platform. Tiny painted details, craftsman's workshop lighting.

cards.title: Stall Layout Map
cards.description: Festival grounds map showing: East Row (morning sun, wine displays), West Row (afternoon light, textile displays), North Row (shared, food vendors), South Row (entertainment stages). Notes: "East=Ashford (last year), West=Birch (last year), North=Shared."
cards.image_prompt: A hand-drawn map on aged parchment showing festival grounds layout with four labeled rows of stalls. Compass rose in the corner. Color-coded sections in crimson, emerald, and gold. Ink illustrations of tiny stalls and stages. Rolled edges, wax seal in the corner.

cards.title: Champion Assembly Rack
cards.description: Seven labeled slots in a chain: 1) Model (from Bazaar), 2) Gateway (from Castle Gate), 3) Memory (from Chronicle Hall), 4) Policy (from King's Seal), 5) Guardrails (from Code of Honor), 6) Observability (Herald's Ledger), 7) Runtime (Deploy). cards.image_prompt: A large wooden rack mounted on a platform with seven carved slots arranged in a chain, each slot labeled with a small brass plate. Some slots glow faintly, awaiting components. The rack is ornate with iron reinforcements. Training ground backdrop, afternoon light, military precision.

cards.title: King's Orders

cards.title: Gate Opened
cards.description: The conduits hum with energy. The portcullis rises. The Gate Warden nods. "You may pass. Scout rank earned."

cards.title: Champion Assembled
cards.description: Sir Cedric nods — almost imperceptibly. "Not bad. Every capability in place. Now run the rehearsal. Prove it works end to end."

cards.title: Festival Ready (ENDING)
cards.description: The Champion completes the rehearsal flawlessly. Sir Cedric actually smiles. The festival is ready. Sundown approaches — and everything is in place.

cards.title: Ally Recruited
cards.description: The Bazaar ally arrives at the Kitchen, ready to search the archives. Greta claps her hands. "Finally! Someone with BRAINS!"

cards.title: Trade Negotiated
cards.description: The Scout and Tongue of Babel work together — trade routes established. Ambassador Kael celebrates with a dance.

cards.title: Performers Booked
cards.description: The Artificer books all performers with royal authority. Mistress Thornbury takes a dramatic bow.

cards.title: Dispute Resolved
cards.description: The Chronicler presents fair evidence under the Code of Honor — both nobles grudgingly accept the arrangement.

cards.title: 📜 Festival History
cards.description: "The Grand Harvest Festival has been held every autumn for 200 years. Each year, the Steward of Errands coordinates the preparations — dispatching knights of the realm to handle tasks too complex for any one person. The secret? Delegation. The right knight, with the right tools, for the right job."

cards.title: 📜 Scroll #0: What is a Knight?
cards.description: "A knight — in the language of the realm — is an agent. A Soldier is the simplest: you give it an instruction (a prompt), and it carries out the task. No tools, no memory, no judgment beyond what you tell it. In the world beyond Cloudmere, this is a foundation model invocation — a single call to Amazon Bedrock. The quality of the result depends entirely on the clarity of your command."

cards.title: 📜 Scroll #2: The Castle Gate
cards.description: "The Castle Gate is the MCP Gateway — the controlled passage connecting your agent to external tools and services. A Soldier stays inside the walls (no tools). A Scout passes through the Gate, gaining the ability to call external APIs, query databases, and interact with services beyond the castle. In AWS terms, this is AgentCore Gateway — connecting Bedrock Agents to external tools via the Model Context Protocol (MCP)."

cards.title: 📜 Scroll #1: The Bazaar of Bedrock
cards.description: "The Bedrock Bazaar is Amazon Bedrock's multi-model selection. Each merchant stall is a foundation model family: Anthropic (Claude), Meta (Llama), Amazon Nova, DeepSeek, Qwen. Choosing the right model for the task is a cost-performance tradeoff. The Bazaar teaches: don't just pick the most powerful model — pick the RIGHT model for the job."

cards.title: 📜 Scroll #3: The King's Seal
cards.description: "The King's Seal is Cedar Policy — a declarative language for defining permissions. Cedar policies specify who (principal) can do what (action) on which resources, under what conditions. 'The bearer may BOOK performers' = Allow action. 'Max 50 gold' = condition. 'Forbidden from hiring Sir Reginald' = Deny rule. Cedar policies are evaluated by AgentCore Identity."

cards.title: 📜 Scroll #4: The Chronicle & The Code
cards.description: "The Chronicle Hall is AgentCore Memory — long-term storage that persists across sessions. A Chronicler knight remembers past conversations, past arrangements, past decisions. But memory without restraint is dangerous. That's why every Chronicler must also follow the Code of Honor — Bedrock Guardrails. Memory + Guardrails = a knight you can trust."

cards.title: 📜 Scroll #5: The Proving Ground
cards.description: "The Proving Ground is AgentCore Runtime — where agents are assembled and deployed. A Champion combines every capability: a foundation model (Bedrock), external tools (Gateway/MCP), long-term memory (AgentCore Memory), permissions (Cedar Policy/Identity), content safety (Guardrails), and action logging (Observability). The deployment lifecycle is: select model → connect tools → attach memory → define policy → configure guardrails → enable observability → deploy to runtime."
